content_sections.heading: MPMRCL Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy has been announced under the Civil domain/sub-domain as follows: As per the general conditions of the notification, the number of posts indicated may vary based on further assessment of requirement by MPMRCL.

content_sections.heading: MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a Government-recognized university or institute. Candidates should have knowledge and working experience in Metro/Railways/RRTS/High Speed Railway Infrastructure projects. Preference is given to candidates with experience in underground transport tunnels, underground stations, and cross passages using TBM/NATM/Cut & Cover methods in Metro/Railways/RRTS/High Speed Railway Infrastructure projects. Candidates should be well versed with activities across the project life cycle, including: Construction of stations, viaducts, and bridges Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) Planning and design Estimation and tendering Construction monitoring and project management Civil works and commissioning of the project Candidates should presently be working/have worked in Railways/Railway PSUs/Metro organisation/Metro PSUs OR a Government Organisation, meeting the following criteria: For Contract/Deputation basis: Minimum 21 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently in IDA pay scale of ₹1,20,000-2,80,000 or CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above, OR working for 2 years in IDA pay scale ₹1,00,000-2,60,000, OR working for 4 years in CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC), OR drawing a consolidated pay of minimum ₹1,40,000/- per month or above while working at the level of GM/E-8 or above in a Government Organisation. For Re-employment basis: Minimum 21 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently working or retired from IDA pay scale of ₹1,20,000-2,80,000 or above, OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above. For Contract/Deputation basis: Minimum 18 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently in IDA pay scale of ₹1,00,000-2,60,000 or above or CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above, OR working for 2 years in IDA pay scale ₹90,000-2,40,000 or 2 years in CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above, OR drawing a consolidated pay from a Government Organisation of minimum ₹1,15,000/- per month or above while working at the level of Additional General Manager-E7 or above. For Re-employment basis: Minimum 18 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently working or retired from IDA pay scale of ₹1,00,000-2,60,000 or above, OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above.

content_sections.heading: MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: MPMRCL reserves the right to shortlist any candidate for interview. Priority for shortlisting will be given based on relevant Metro experience and seniority in the desired pay scale. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through the registered e-mail ID provided at the time of application submission. No separate communication by post will be sent. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear for an interview through online or offline mode on the scheduled date and time, along with all original documents, testimonials, and experience certificates. No request for change in the schedule date and time of the interview will be entertained. Management reserves the right to conduct a written test for the posts, if required. MPMRCL may relax the selection criteria in case of candidates with good experience in a similar project. Candidates shortlisted for the screening process will be eligible for reimbursement of train fare as per MPMRCL policy, if the interview is scheduled through offline mode.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must enclose all self-certified copies of the following documents along with the application: Age proof (Matriculation Certificate or equivalent) Essential Qualification certificate as prescribed in the notification Experience certificate(s) of ex-employer(s), Appointment order/Office order of joining the current organisation Office order showing present pay-scale and promotion to present grade Summarised brief description of relevant experience Latest salary slip (3 months) NOC and Vigilance Clearance by the present employer, or an undertaking as applicable, for candidates applying from Metro Rail/Railway/Railway PSUs/Government Organisation/PSUs Copies of APAR (Annual Performance Appraisal Report) for the last 5 years for the posts of General Manager and Additional General Manager Self-declaration by candidates working on consolidated pay for a Government organisation, confirming they are working/have worked at the level of the post as per the eligibility prescribed Non-submission of documents as required will lead to rejection of candidature at any stage during the recruitment process. Original documents will need to be shown during the interview or after selection, with two sets of photocopies submitted along with the filled application form at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 24 August 2026, till 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 posts have been announced for General Manager/Additional General Manager under the Civil domain.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a Government-recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates must send the filled application in the prescribed Annexure-I format by post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by mode of appointment: maximum 58 or 60 years for deputation (depending on parent organisation’s retirement age), 55–63 years for re-employment, and maximum 57 years for contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for General Manager and Additional General Manager posts at MPMRCL?
faq.answer: General Manager (E-8) carries an IDA pay scale of ₹1,20,000–2,80,000 on contract basis, while Additional General Manager (E-7) carries ₹1,00,000–2,60,000 on contract basis. Deputation and re-employment pay structures differ, as detailed in the salary section above.
